trailhead.label: Fort du Murier car park above Gières, the board’s start

cautions: About a third of the loop is on quiet hamlet roads; the D 112 is reached at the Le Murier crossroads.
Stony, earthy tracks and a sunken lane that can be muddy after rain.
Low altitude (about 430–580 m): warm on summer afternoons.
No water point is listed on this walk: carry enough for you and your dog.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.
